intro.speaker: Yardmaster Holler
lines: RIGHT! NEW RECRUIT! Sparring board, rung one: THE TWINS UGG!
One of them spars. The other one shouts advice. The advice is bad. GO!

intro.speaker: Yardmaster Holler
lines: Rung two! She trains the Little Crushers, our youngest! She spars with a RATTLE! MATRON SORREL!
And two of her biggest babies, all grown up. GO!

intro.speaker: Yardmaster Holler
lines: Rung three! Nine years in this yard, never once hit! FENNICK THE UNBITTEN!
He's brought friends to do the hitting. He's going to run. GO!

intro.speaker: Yardmaster Holler
lines: Rung four! Nobody knows who he is! THE MASKED BRUTE!
(It's Captain Varga. Everybody knows. She trains here on her day off.) GO!

intro.speaker: Yardmaster Holler
lines: THE TOP OF THE BOARD! Forty years, never knocked off it! MASTER-AT-ARMS HROTH!
He looks tired. He looks hopeful, actually. And three of his best recruits, who want his spot. GO!

W: The yard wall. Straw dummies lean against it, every one with Kaldor's face painted on. They have all been hit a great deal.
c: A torch in an iron cage. The sand smells of it, and of sweat.
1: The yard gate, out to the Ring Ward.

objects.name: Yardmaster Holler
lines: I'm the Yardmaster. Every fighter the king owns learns to fight in this yard. Tithe fighters too, before he sends them to the Kaloseum.
The sparring board's on the gate. Five names. Beat the next one, and come back for the one after.
Your name's at the top of the sparring board. I chalked it myself.
Forty years I've been shouting 'HROTH WINS'. I've got to learn to shout a new name. Give me a minute.

answer: The king's Training Yard. Recruits, tithe fighters, captains on their day off. Everyone spars, and the board says who's best.
Whoever's top of the board is master-at-arms. That's been Hroth for forty years.
Never. He watches from the castle wall with a spyglass. He has never once clapped.
Once, he nodded. Hroth's first spar. Forty years ago. The recruits still talk about the nod.

questions.ask: Do you ever use your indoor voice?
answer: MY OUTDOOR VOICE. IS ILLEGAL. IN THREE WARDS.

objects.name: Ogg Ugg
lines: Advice! Duck when they swing! No, the other way! No, jump! Not like that!
I'm the twin who shouts. Ugg's the twin who spars. We swap on Thursdays. It goes badly.
You beat Ugg! My advice was wrong. It always is. It's a family tradition.

answer: Depends. Do I have a black eye? Then it's Thursday.
Ugg says shouting is harder than fighting. Ugg's never been hit by Hroth.
…Ugg says I'm the useless twin too. On Thursdays. Then I say it back on Fridays.
